attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) as an HAProxy load-balancing frontend on TCP 80 of its LAN/management address (10.100.168.10), round-robining across node2 and node3, each of which serves identifying HTTP content on port 8080. Verified node4 receives alternating responses from both backends through the single entry point. Completed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes with confirmed boot-identity changes and post-restart service/data recovery.
